thread:
kate: Quick follow-up from the RFC: operator-proxy pattern for service→project auth. thinking: proxy either (A) mint short-lived project-scoped JWTs with claims {proj,actor,exp} (baked by proxy) OR (B) forward original service token and set X-Project header for downstream enforcement. pros/cons?

mike: @kate :thinking: Option A centralizes authz checks (downstream sees token origin + claims) but proxy becomes minting authority — keying + rotation pain. Also increases token churn, could hit auth service QPS.

olivia: Option B is simpler and lower QPS but forces every downstream to trust proxy header. If someone bypasses proxy or misconfigures L7, header spoof is risk. Need mTLS + immutability of proxy network path.

sam: Could we hybrid? proxy mints opaque short-lived bearer that maps back to project claim in introspection service. That keeps downstream naive but allows revocation. adds introspect latency.

mike: Also RBAC: if we bake org vs project scopes in tokens, rollouts are easier. But project-scoped tokens would require per-project role mapping — duplication. Might want canonical role ids (org:role/project:role) in claims.

olivia: For API key migration: we should keep prefixing keys with meta (e.g., p- for project, s- for service, o- for org), easiest for routing but not authz. Ensure keys never sent to clients.

kate: Quick strawman constraints: 1) least privilege: project token lifetime max 15m. 2) proxy must authenticate to mint endpoint using mTLS+client cert. 3) downstream verifies issuer+kid or hits introspect cache. 4) fallback header path only allowed from trusted subnets.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: auth-proxy v2 canary deployed to staging at 3225006820 :rocket:

mike: Can we measure QPS impact? need perf test with 1000 rps and 5s introspect latency. If introspect is slow we need cache TTL=5s with jitter.

kate: Action items: olivia — prototype minting flow and introspect cache (due EOW). sam — design prefix strategy for keys + migration doc. mike — perf harness + SLO targets. I'll own an RFC follow-up doc.

olivia: ack. posting quick curl example for hybrid minting:

```
# proxy mints short-lived token
curl -X POST https://auth.internal/mint
  -H "Authorization: Bearer proxy-token"
  -d '{"project":"proj-123","aud":"redwood-svc","ttl":600}'
# downstream receives token:
Authorization: Bearer ey...
# or header fallback:
X-Project: proj-123
```

sam: Also note telemetry: add token-origin tag to traces and cost counters.

kate: Cool. let's sync tomorrow 10am if needed. :thumbsup:
